title: Ministry of New & Renewable Energy Reviews Progress of Swachhata and File Disposal under Special Campaign 6.0
body_text: The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) undertook a review of cleanliness in its office sections and the status of file disposal under Special Campaign 6, aimed at institutionalising Swachhata and minimising pendency in government offices. On 26th October 2026, Shri Aditya Pratap Singh, Director, MNRE, accompanied by Shri Rajat Yadav, Under Secretary, inspected various sections of the Ministry at Atal Akshaya Urja Bhawan, Lodhi Road, New Delhi. During the inspection, the officers reviewed the maintenance and organisation of office spaces and emphasised the need to ensure cleanliness and proper utilisation of available space. The status of file disposal was also reviewed, with emphasis on the timely processing of files and expeditious clearance of pending cases. The review reiterated the importance of regular monitoring, efficient file management and the active participation of officers and staff in achieving the objectives of Special Campaign 6. MNRE remains committed to promoting Swachhata, improving workplace organisation and reducing pendency through sustained efforts and effective administrative practices. *** NS/LL
